use-lightbox.label: useLightbox named import
use-lightbox._comment: The composable only: it reads the controller a group or provider supplies. Measured 533 B (2026-11-15); limit = measured + 5%, rounded up to 10 B.

photo-image.label: PhotoImage component import
photo-image._comment: Image rendering, provider resolution, photo-data validation, shared load-ahead observation and decoded placeholder-colour handoff. Measured 3,102 B (2026-11-15); limit = measured + 5%, rounded up to 10 B.

all.label: full package import
all._comment: Every runtime export: the eager entry plus the lazy viewer chunk, compressed separately and summed. Measured 52,342 B (2026-11-17, after the lightbox motion work; 49,700 B before it); limit = measured + 5%, rounded up to 10 B.

responsive.label: responsive named import
responsive._comment: The responsive() helper alone. Measured 657 B (2026-11-15); limit = measured + 5%, rounded up to 10 B.

module.label: module enabled, no usage
module._comment: Structure CSS without the lightbox (it loads with the viewer), config injection, native provider defaults and Nuxt label templates. Measured 1,927 B (2026-11-15); limit = measured + 5%, rounded up to 10 B.

usage.label: module enabled with PhotoImage usage
usage._comment: As above plus provider-based PhotoImage rendering and photo-data validation. Measured 1,977 B (2026-11-15); limit = measured + 5%, rounded up to 10 B.

album.label: module enabled with PhotoAlbum usage
album._comment: All chunks of an album page: the eager part, the lazy viewer chunk and its lightbox CSS. Measured 40,362 B (2026-11-15); limit = measured + 5%, rounded up to 10 B.

album-eager.label: album, before interaction
album-eager._comment: What an album page loads before the viewer chunk: the client entry, its static imports and CSS. Mostly the seven album layouts, photo validation, PhotoImage and the album labels. Measured 19,477 B (2026-11-15); limit = measured + 5%, rounded up to 10 B.
